user_story: As a user, I want the system to return an error when I try to get a task with a non-existent ID so that I know the task does not exist.

positive.title: Retrieve existing task by valid ID
steps: Send a GET request to the task endpoint with a valid task ID that exists in the system
Verify that the task details returned match the expected task details
positive.expected_result: The system returns a 200 OK status and the correct task details in the response body.

negative.title: Retrieve task with non-existent ID
steps: Send a GET request to the task endpoint with a non-existent task ID
Verify the error message returned in the response
negative.expected_result: The system returns a 404 Not Found status and an error message indicating the task does not exist.

edge.title: Retrieve task with an ID in an unexpected format
steps: Send a GET request to the task endpoint with a task ID formatted as a string (e.g., 'abc123')
Verify the error message returned in the response
edge.expected_result: The system returns a 400 Bad Request status and an error message indicating that the ID format is invalid.
